title: Capture provenance labels
responsibility: Explains capture origin and acceptance separately from the revision a verification attempt targeted.

inputs.name: captureProvenance.record
inputs.description: The record supplies its identifier, validity, outcome, and target commit for the standing and verification wording. An invalid record is reported as unvalidated.

inputs.name: captureProvenance.scenario
inputs.description: The scenario supplies inheritance and the tested revision; inherited scenarios also supply the originating record and commit. The tested revision is verification context, not the capture's source.

inputs.name: captureProvenance.capture
inputs.description: The capture supplies status and optional server build and revision, while kind and provenance determine whether a build stamp is expected. A rejected capture is labeled as from another revision when its recorded server revision differs from the scenario's tested revision.

inputs.name: scenarioOrigin.scenario
inputs.description: The scenario supplies inheritance, tested revision, status, and capture revisions. Capture revisions affect the wording only for a failed, non-inherited scenario, where distinct revisions other than the tested revision are listed.

outputs.name: captureProvenance
outputs.description: The result contains the capture's standing, display label, labeled facts, and a sentence note. Record validity takes precedence over capture failure; a rejected label can identify a different recorded revision or a missing required build stamp.

examples.label: Fresh capture
examples.note: Captured from build build-2026-11-15-1842 of revision 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567. Provenance: actual capture of running software. Tested at 0123456 by passing record record_01J9Q.

outputs.name: scenarioOrigin
outputs.description: The result summarizes an inherited origin, a passed tested revision, or a failed attempt. For failed non-inherited scenarios it appends distinct recorded capture revisions that differ from the tested revision.
